main.rationale: Holds script_mod/version/debug + script_macros (macros, framework, logging, guards). Expands into lib.

core.rationale: 27 root fns + geo/14 span the tick, the geo kernels, the diagnostics, the PP registry and the shared accessors.

actions.rationale: 4 fns, one domain: altimeter and weather report; 1 setting.

ai.rationale: 16 fns, one domain: agent register/sense/decide, stimulus, disturbance, tick; 1 setting.

armour.rationale: 4 fns, one domain: armour penetration; 4 settings, all armour.

atmos.rationale: 24 fns (physics/14, state/8, wind/1 plus dumpState) feed the one atmospheric state consumed by core; 13 settings.

ballistics.rationale: 31 fns are one model: the exterior/interior solver plus its runtime data projection; 3 settings.

compat_realweather.rationale: One host adaptation: Real Weather read.

fx.rationale: 32 fns across particle/16, weather/13, blast/2 plus dumpState; the particle pipeline is the engine the weather FX consume.

maritime.rationale: 7 fns: tides/sea state vs magnetism; the 4 settings are all sea/tide.

material.rationale: 7 fns, one domain: surface/material lookup + calculateStefanCoefficient. Must not move (issue #203 cycle-breaker).

mobility.rationale: 39 root + hydrology/5 + common/1; settings are independently gated for ground, flight, vehicles and hydrology.

nightvision.rationale: ltm/8 with independent ltmEnabled/ltmDaylightFade vs 14 tube-model fns with nvg* settings.

optics.rationale: 8 function folders and 11 config fragments: sensor/fx, eye, vision+grade+perception, symbology, hud, map config.

physiology.rationale: 7 subfolders and independently gated settings; clothing/18 is a pure equipment-data lookup.

radio.rationale: 3 fns, one domain: radio propagation; 4 settings.

thermal.rationale: 10 subfolders; the view settings are independent of the physics settings; config roots differ.

wildlife.rationale: 51 fns; ambientEnabled and animalsEnabled are independent gates; the acoustic/call/sound fns are the ambience.

environmental.rationale: 6 function folders and CfgWorlds: sky/lighting, weather, ground-state persistence.
